findings.title: Decision promotion may omit rubric/evidence/subject freshness

findings.title: Acceptance authorship may omit the decision author behind a wrapper artifact
findings.logic: Excluded authors comprise proposal author and direct proposed_value Artifact.produced_by. The selected DecisionReceipt.recorded_by and transitive candidate authors are not included.

Require rejection of self-authored candidate promotion despite the intermediate wrapper; verify another independent principal remains a positive control.
